context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren assess a product's readiness.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business review; vocabulary (体系/性能/至る/伴う/充分) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 製品の性能は、十分かね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 性能は、充分に達しています。
lines.en: Performance has sufficiently reached the mark.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発売に至るまで、課題はあるかね?
lines.en: Are there issues before reaching launch?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 宣伝の手間が、伴います。
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 管理の体系は、整っているかね?
lines.en: Is the management system in order?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 体系を整え、充分に備えました。
lines.en: I ordered the system and prepared fully.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: リスクも、伴うのを忘れずにな。
lines.en: Don't forget risk is involved too.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 成功に至るよう、全力を尽くします。
lines.en: I'll do my utmost to reach success.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
